name: Blackfinger's Prayer
source: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
description: The trapdoor's metal is infused with a deadly toxin that seeps out when the trap is triggered.
disable: DC 50 Thievery check (legendary) to gum up the trapdoor's porous metal surface, DC 45 Crafting check (master) to render the toxin inert, or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 45) to counteract the trap's magic

offensiveAbilities.name: Blackfinger's Prayer
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the door without first whispering the name Blackfingers

Effect The metal trapdoor emits toxic vapors. Each creature within 30 feet must save against a potent strain of Blackfinger Blight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blackfinger Blight
offensiveAbilities.description:
Each round, at the beginning of their turn, a creature affected by blackfinger blight must succeed at a DC 5 Flat check or drop one random item they're holding

Saving Throw DC 40 Fortitude save

Onset 1 round

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 6d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 8d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 3 10d6 poison damage and Confused (1 round)
